topic: Someone finds their childhood teddy bear at a yard sale
text: Oh my gosh, can you believe it? I was just minding my own business, flipping through old records and knick-knacks, and there it was—my teddy, the one I thought was long gone, lost in a move years back. His ear’s a bit frayed, and he’s seen better days, but he’s still my teddy. You know, the one Mom fixed with a patch and I hugged every night? I couldn’t just leave him there. I know it sounds crazy, but it’s like a piece of my childhood came calling. I hope it’s okay that I brought him home. He still feels like a good luck charm, like everything’s going to be alright.
